## {.nostretch}

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:24px 52px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;overflow:hidden;">

  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:22px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;">Model Evaluation: What We Measured</h1>
  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px;">

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:16px 12px 0 12px;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:14px;">Evaluation design</div>

      <div style="display:grid;gap:13px;font-size:18.4px;line-height:1.28;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Held-out test set:</strong> final model performance was checked on unseen data.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Same split:</strong> all models used the same train-test split for fair comparison.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">3-class target:</strong> we predicted Dissatisfied, Neutral, and Satisfied.</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Class-level check:</strong> we checked whether each class was actually recognised.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:16px 12px 0 12px;">
      <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:14px;">Why Macro F1 matters</div>

      <div style="font-size:18.4px;line-height:1.34;color:#344054;">
        The target is imbalanced. A model can get acceptable accuracy by mainly predicting the largest class. Macro F1 is more suitable because it gives the three classes equal weight.
      </div>

      <div style="margin-top:22px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:12px;padding:15px 17px;">
        <div style="font-size:18.4px;line-height:1.25;color:#1f2a44;font-weight:720;">Main metric: Macro F1</div>
        <div style="font-size:16.8px;line-height:1.28;color:#475467;margin-top:6px;">
          It helps us judge whether the model predicts all satisfaction groups fairly.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:48px;">

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:14px 10px 0 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Accuracy</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.2px;line-height:1.26;color:#344054;">Overall correct prediction rate.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:14px 10px 0 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Macro F1</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.2px;line-height:1.26;color:#344054;">Main score for balanced prediction.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:14px 10px 0 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Kappa</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.2px;line-height:1.26;color:#344054;">Checks agreement beyond chance.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:14px 10px 0 10px;">
      <div style="font-size:21px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Recall</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.2px;line-height:1.26;color:#344054;">Shows which classes are missed.</div>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>
```

## {.nostretch}

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:22px 50px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;overflow:hidden;">

  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;">Model Evaluation: Overall Test Results</h1>
  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid #d7dee8;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;">

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 105px 105px 105px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">Model</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">Accuracy</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">Kappa</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">Macro F1</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;">Why this result makes sense</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 105px 105px 105px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:18.7px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Random Forest</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.665</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.237</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.472</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.3px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">
        Handles non-linear feature interactions, so it gives the best balanced score.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 105px 105px 105px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:18.7px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Gradient Boosting</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.688</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.241</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.471</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.3px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">
        Learns errors step by step, but class overlap limits extra improvement.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 105px 105px 105px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:18.7px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Logistic Regression</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.639</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.232</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.462</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.3px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">
        Stable baseline, but its linear boundary misses complex patterns.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 105px 105px 105px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:18.7px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Naive Bayes</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.709</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.178</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.435</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.3px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">
        Highest accuracy, but its independence assumption weakens class balance.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 105px 105px 105px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;align-items:center;">
      <div style="font-size:18.7px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">Neural Network</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.677</div>
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">0.234</div>
      <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;text-align:center;">0.404</div>
      <div style="font-size:15.3px;line-height:1.2;color:#344054;">
        Needs clearer signals; overlapping tabular data limits its Macro F1.
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:24px;">

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Best balanced model</div>
      <div style="font-size:17px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;">Random Forest had the highest Macro F1.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Accuracy warning</div>
      <div style="font-size:17px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;">Naive Bayes had the highest accuracy, but weaker class balance.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Main lesson</div>
      <div style="font-size:17px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;">Balanced metrics are more reliable than accuracy alone.</div>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>
```

```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:24px 52px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;overflow:hidden;">

  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:22px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;">Model Evaluation: Class-Level Diagnosis</h1>
  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:stretch;">

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:15px 14px 14px 14px;background:#ffffff;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:228px;">
      <div style="font-size:23px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Dissatisfied</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;min-height:44px;">Smallest group, hardest to recognise.</div>
      <div style="font-size:38px;line-height:1;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;margin:14px 0 4px 0;">0.275</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;color:#475467;margin-bottom:12px;">F1-score</div>
      <div style="background:#eef2f7;border-radius:999px;height:12px;overflow:hidden;">
        <div style="width:29%;height:12px;background:#315f9f;border-radius:999px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:15.5px;color:#475467;margin-top:7px;">Recall: 29.0%</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:15px 14px 14px 14px;background:#ffffff;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:228px;">
      <div style="font-size:23px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Neutral</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;min-height:44px;">Middle group, close to both sides.</div>
      <div style="font-size:38px;line-height:1;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;margin:14px 0 4px 0;">0.315</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;color:#475467;margin-bottom:12px;">F1-score</div>
      <div style="background:#eef2f7;border-radius:999px;height:12px;overflow:hidden;">
        <div style="width:27.5%;height:12px;background:#315f9f;border-radius:999px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:15.5px;color:#475467;margin-top:7px;">Recall: 27.5%</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:15px 14px 14px 14px;background:#ffffff;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:228px;">
      <div style="font-size:23px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Satisfied</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.5px;line-height:1.24;color:#344054;min-height:44px;">Largest group, easiest to predict.</div>
      <div style="font-size:38px;line-height:1;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;margin:14px 0 4px 0;">0.822</div>
      <div style="font-size:16px;color:#475467;margin-bottom:12px;">F1-score</div>
      <div style="background:#eef2f7;border-radius:999px;height:12px;overflow:hidden;">
        <div style="width:85.1%;height:12px;background:#315f9f;border-radius:999px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:15.5px;color:#475467;margin-top:7px;">Recall: 85.1%</div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:30px;">

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Pattern 1</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.2px;line-height:1.25;color:#344054;">Dissatisfied is weak because there are fewer cases and weaker signals.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Pattern 2</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.2px;line-height:1.25;color:#344054;">Neutral is difficult because it sits between negative and positive satisfaction.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="border-top:3px solid #315f9f;padding:12px 8px 0 8px;">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Pattern 3</div>
      <div style="font-size:17.2px;line-height:1.25;color:#344054;">Satisfied is much easier because it is the largest and clearest class.</div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div style="margin-top:auto;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 18px;">
    <div style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.26;color:#1f2a44;font-weight:720;text-align:center;">
      Key point: after trying to handle class imbalance, the main limit is that the three classes are close in the data and do not have enough strong separating features.
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```
